topic.title: Planning Obligations / Section 106 / Monitoring
topic.source_contract: necessity, direct relationship, scale and kind, obligation heads, triggers, indexation, payment, in-kind delivery, affordable housing, highways agreement interface, deed execution, land binding, monitoring fee, infrastructure funding statement, discharge, enforcement and delivered outcome evidence

scope_guards: Heads of terms are not an executed section 106 agreement.
A committee resolution is not a completed deed.
A contribution figure is not evidence of payment.
Payment is not evidence of infrastructure delivery.
A monitoring fee is not monitoring evidence.
An obligation trigger is not assumed to have occurred.
Discharge is not inferred from elapsed time.
No score or promotion is written without executed, triggered, delivered and monitored obligations.
